perFrameCode: //HEAD MOVEMENT x0,y0,z0 based on z-move in HEAD Coords
reg50 = q20; reg51 = q21; reg52 = q22;
reg53 = q23; reg54 = q24; reg55 = q25;
reg56 = q26; reg57 = q27; reg58 = q28;
//  colr /= sum; colg /= sum; colb/= sum; ,0);
vx = vx1; vy = vy1; vz = vz1;
vx = vx1; vy = vy1; vz = vz1; ran = -v0*dt*rand(100)/100;
//SPARK and HEAD COORD for use in comp shader
x0_ = gmegabuf(point)-reg07; y0_ = gmegabuf(point+1)-reg08; z0_ = gmegabuf(point+2)-reg09;
xcam = xcam +dxcam; ycam = ycam +dycam; zcam = zcam +dzcam;
reg07 = xcam; reg08 = ycam; reg09 = zcam;
c1 = cos(v1); c2 = cos(v2); c3 = cos(v3);
s1 = sin(v1); s2 = sin(v2); s3 = sin(v3);
q1 = cos(crot);q2 = sin(crot); q3 = - q2; q4 = q1;
perFrameInitCode: //The camera tries to follow the head of the firework and look into its direction
//Camera speed and rotational speed is limited, camera lags behind
//Camera angle is forced back into horizontal position
gSpeed = 1;   //global speed, affects all other speeds
CamDist  = .01; //camera tries to keep this distance
CamLock = 8;   //how fast does camera angle lock on firework
HLock = .1;    //force camera angle back into horizontal view
sharp = 140;    //sharpness of bass/treb triggered head direction changes
c1 = cos(0); c2 = cos(0); c3 = cos(0);
s1 = sin(0); s2 = sin(0); s3 = sin(0);
colr = rand(10)/11; colg = rand(10)/11; colb = rand(10)/11;

perFrameCode: //#Farbe mu in megabuf gebuffert werden, sonst aendert tail ploetzlich Farbe
r = min(1,a*4); g = a; b = pow(a,5); ; //#extra col var !
